nodes.name: Ancestral Bond
nodes.flavour:
A wooden construct, mute and blind.
But fear the wrath of shackled mind.

nodes.name: Avatar of Fire
nodes.flavour: "In my dreams I see a great warrior, his skin scorched black, his fists aflame."

nodes.flavour:
Let the Darkness consume you.
Beyond the veil of death,
there burns a black fire.

nodes.name: Blood Magic
nodes.flavour: Lay open your veins, and draw power from your own spilled life.

nodes.name: Bulwark
nodes.flavour: In battle, certainty is worth a little pain.

nodes.flavour: Give up everything in pursuit of greatness - even life itself.

nodes.name: Crimson Assault

nodes.name: Dance with Death
nodes.flavour: You circle the black scorpion with enmity, daring it time and again.

nodes.name: Eldritch Battery

What need have I for defence when my enemies
are reduced to ash and splinters?

nodes.name: Elemental Equilibrium
nodes.flavour: Balance is good in all things, but especially in the realm of magic.

nodes.name: Eternal Youth
nodes.flavour: Burn the spirit to vitalise the flesh.

nodes.name: Giant's Blood
nodes.flavour: The Titans did not vanish from this world. Their might lives on - in you.

nodes.name: Glancing Blows
nodes.flavour: Utter trust in your defence unleashes ultimate potential.

nodes.flavour: Skip a beat, hold your breath. Too slow a poison, only death.

nodes.flavour: The body is a weapon waiting to be mastered.

nodes.name: Iron Reflexes
nodes.flavour: Why should I dodge blows that I do not fear?

nodes.name: Mind Over Matter
nodes.flavour: While the mind endures, so too will the body.

nodes.flavour: I give you everything, my pets. Do not disappoint me.

nodes.name: Oasis
nodes.flavour: The fewer there are, the less you have to share.

nodes.name: Pain Attunement

Embrace the pain, drink it in.
Your enemies will know your agony tenfold.

nodes.name: Resolute Technique
nodes.flavour: Great tacticians learn that consistency often trumps potential.

nodes.name: Resonance
nodes.flavour: The notes may change, but the song remains the same.

nodes.name: Ritual Cadence
nodes.flavour: A properly disciplined mind gives rise to structured thought.

nodes.name: Trusted Kinship
nodes.flavour: Bonds forged in battle surpass ties of blood.

nodes.name: Unwavering Stance

Stand your ground, child, keep your senses.
The pain is fleeting, but victory is forever.

only from the ravaged flesh of my enemies.
